name: p13c_nmr_polarity
formula: Delta T2 = isotope x activity interaction on water-1H T2; former sign-aware rule (reject the sign-positive branch on a powered, significant negative interaction) held pending redesign; design sketch only, no observed NMR data
tier: Tier 3 material-response sign hypothesis (ordinary isotope/spin-coherence material mechanism; no phason or Level-II content) conditional on O.21/O.33 + Tier 3 active-state Delta T2 calibration anchor pending O.21/O.33
app_psc_precision_str: OPEN_CONDITIONAL design sketch (sign-aware rule held pending redesign; no outcome supports or rejects the branch until then): n=24 per isotope, 3 repeated acquisitions, 99% bootstrap CI [0.0136, 0.0861], systematic floor 2e-07 of T2, design-sketch primary power 0.800, simulated beta 0.201, design-sketch replication-pair power 0.638

power_statistic.pilot_variance_acceptance_threshold: Non-operative while the gate is held pending redesign. After the redesign, a decisive 5% support/rejection of the registered polarity branch would require pilot total per-preparation sigma fraction <= max_total_per_preparation_sigma_fraction_for_80pct_power.

extra.decision_rule: Held pending redesign. As written the gate rejected by construction (17O shortens water-1H T2 by scalar relaxation). The former sign-aware rule -- reject the registered sign-positive branch on a powered, significant negative isotope x activity interaction in water-1H Delta T2, Delta T2 = [T2(17O,active) - T2(17O,inactive)] - [T2(16O,active) - T2(16O,inactive)] -- applies only after the redesign; until then no outcome supports or rejects the branch. Neither outcome would be a verdict on GCT as a whole, and no phason, Selection-Operator or Level-II inference follows (V1 Ch17 §17.1.3).
extra.scope: Design-sketch power calculation; gate held pending redesign; lab-data status open.
